The image EM1111_RECODEC_VISUAL_PROOF.png was rendered from the supplied EM1111.EMD
with the existing recodec_c89 animated textured viewer before RE1codec was built.

Command semantics:
  view: iso
  animation: enabled
  bank: B
  clip: 3
  frame: 10

Viewer report:
  faces=648
  texrefs=648
  TIM=256x256 type=1 CLUT=256x2
  emd_type=0x410000
  hierarchy=emr_partlist
  pose=82
  step=1

This proof is only to demonstrate that the reference codec path can assemble and
texture the model. RE1codec itself is a decoder/validation library and does not
hardwire a renderer.
